---
title: "Privacy"
---

*Last updated: 13 August 2026*

**Raccoon Backgammon collects nothing.** There is no account to create, no
tracking, no analytics, no advertising, and no cookies.

## Where the engine runs

The neural network runs **in your browser**. When you load the play or analyse
page, your browser downloads the network's weights once and evaluates positions
locally on your own machine. Positions you play or paste are never transmitted
to us — there is no server to transmit them to, and no game data leaves your
device.

## What the host can see

This site is static and served by GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub
receives the technical information your browser sends when requesting a page —
IP address, user agent, and the URL requested — and may log it. That processing
is GitHub's, described in the
[GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-privacy-statement).
We have no access to those logs and add no tracking of our own.

## Email

If you email [{{< var company.email >}}](mailto:{{< var company.email >}}) we
keep the message so we can reply. We do not add you to any mailing list — there
isn't one.

## Your rights

Since we hold no personal data beyond correspondence you choose to send, there
is normally nothing to access, correct or erase. If you have written to us and
want that correspondence deleted, ask and we will delete it.

**Data controller:** {{< var company.name >}}, CVR {{< var company.cvr >}},
